subject: Offline bundle signing: key ceremony scheduling + approval checklist
related_links: Jira INT-11021 (signing operator role access request)
Confluence: Offline bundle signing key ceremony + evidence guide (draft)
body:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 7, 2025 at 4:12 PM PT
Subject: Offline bundle signing: key ceremony scheduling + approval checklist
Attachments: Signing-Key-Ceremony-Checklist_v0.4.docx

Aisha / Marcus,

We’re ready to run the initial signing key ceremony for the Redwood Private offline bundle signing flow.

Goal (ceremony output)
- Create Redwood “Offline Bundle Signing” key material in the approved custody model (HSM-backed)
- Publish the corresponding public key(s) + metadata for installer trust store ingestion
- Capture evidence artifacts for customer security reviews + internal audit (who/what/when)

Proposed attendees (minimum)
- Release Eng: me (operator), plus a second Release Eng witness (I’ll add once we confirm availability)
- Security: Marcus (security reviewer)
- Security leadership/GRC approval: Aisha (final approval / policy sign-off)

Scheduling options next week (PT)
- Tue 11/11 10:00–11:00
- Wed 11/12 2:00–3:00
- Thu 11/13 9:00–10:00

Logistics
- Video call + screen share; no recording unless you prefer (we can rely on screenshots + exported logs)
- Evidence capture: HSM operation logs (where available), GitHub Actions run links, key fingerprint, approvals, and storage location

Asks
1) Can you confirm a 60-min slot from above?
2) Marcus: please sanity check the checklist attached and call out any must-have steps before we do this.
3) Aisha: please confirm the approval expectation (email ack is fine) and any required language for evidence.

Notes
- We’ll keep private key material in the signing service / HSM boundary; only public key + fingerprint goes into the installer trust store.
- We want to avoid bricking air-gapped installs, so we’ll plan for multi-key trust store + rotation from day 1.

Thanks,
Connor

Connor O'Brien
Release Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference


---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Nov 7, 2025 at 5:01 PM PT
Subject: Re: Offline bundle signing: key ceremony scheduling + approval checklist

Connor,

Checklist looks close. A few additions/edits I’d like before we run it:

- Two-person integrity: explicitly name “Operator” and “Approver/Witness” for each critical action (key generation, enabling signing, publishing trust material).
- Evidence: include (a) key fingerprint, (b) key ID / label in HSM, (c) access control snapshot (who had signing operator role at ceremony time).
- Storage: specify where evidence goes + permissions (read-only for Release Eng; Security has read).
- Pre-flight: confirm INT-11021 approvals complete (or list equivalent) before touching keys.
- Break-glass: add a line that break-glass unsigned bundles require separate exception approval (so nobody infers ceremony approval == exception approval).

On scheduling: I can do Wed 11/12 2–3 PM PT or Thu 11/13 9–10 AM PT.

-Marcus

Marcus Lin
Security Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference


---

From: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, Nov 8, 2025 at 9:18 AM PT
Subject: Re: Offline bundle signing: key ceremony scheduling + approval checklist

Wed 11/12 2:00–3:00 PM PT works.

A few requirements from my side:
- I want an explicit “what this key can sign” statement captured in the evidence (scope limitation). This matters for customer questionnaires.
- Confirm we are not distributing any private material to laptops/people. If there is any temporary export (even encrypted), that needs pre-approval and a note in the ceremony record.
- The approval should be: (1) Marcus confirms checklist completed, then (2) I reply to the thread with approval to “activate for production signing.”

No call recording necessary. Screenshots + logs are fine as long as they’re stored in the evidence folder and immutable after the fact (PDF export or equivalent).

-Aisha

Dr. Aisha Rahman
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference


---

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, Nov 9, 2025 at 6:42 PM PT
Subject: Re: Offline bundle signing: key ceremony scheduling + approval checklist

Thanks all.

One product/program ask: can we make sure the ceremony output includes the “customer consumable” artifacts list?
- Public key distribution format (file name, location, and how it ships with the installer)
- Fingerprint that Support/SE can use to validate with customers
- Any installer version constraints for trusting this key (or where that gets documented)

We’re on track to tell pilot customers that signed bundles are the default path, so we need crisp, repeatable wording.

Vivek

Vivek Kulkarni
Product, Redwood Private
Redwood Inference


---

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 9:37 AM PT
Subject: Re: Offline bundle signing: key ceremony scheduling + approval checklist

Locked: Wed 11/12 2:00–3:00 PM PT. I’ll send the calendar invite.

Updates based on notes:
- I’ve revised the checklist to add (1) two-person integrity mapping per action, (2) evidence artifacts list incl. access snapshot, (3) scope statement (“Offline Bundle Signing: manifests + signature envelopes only”), and (4) explicit note that break-glass is a separate exception process.
- I’ll include a one-page “customer-consumable artifacts” section: public key file naming, fingerprint, and how it is shipped/updated in air-gapped environments.

Open items we should close before Wed:
1) Confirm the second witness from Release Eng (I’m lining up coverage today).
2) Verify access approvals for the signing operator role are in place (referencing INT-11021).
3) Decide where to publish the public key for internal consumption pre-GA (likely in the private installer repo + release artifact, but we can confirm in the call).

Aisha: per your request, we’ll end the ceremony with Marcus confirming completion in-thread, and then your “activate for production signing” reply.

Connor


---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dr. Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, Nov 10, 2025 at 11:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Offline bundle signing: key ceremony scheduling + approval checklist

Sounds good.

Two small preferences:
- Evidence immutability: after the session, export the final ceremony notes to PDF and store alongside the logs/screenshots.
- For the “scope statement,” include a sentence that the key is NOT used for container image signing (to prevent confusion with other supply-chain initiatives).

I’ll review the updated checklist before Wed and call out any blockers.

-Marcus
